loading.title: Ashfall Vale
loading.subtitle: Hearthstead · Levels 1 to 10
tips: Hold the right mouse button to steer; hold both to run.
Right-click a creature to attack it, a person to talk.
Shades cannot cross into a hearth's light.
Gather from trees, ore and bushes with a right click.
Press C for your character, B for bags, P for your spellbook.
Recall (the - key) takes you home to your bed or Hearthstead.

lines: For three hundred years the Great Hearth kept Ashfall Vale safe.
Then, one winter night, it went out.
Now Shades rise with the dark, and the people of Hearthstead huddle by its cold stones.
Old Brannoc, the Hearthkeeper, believes the fire can be woken.
intro.toast: Right-click Old Brannoc (the gold !) to begin

classes.prompt: The Great Hearth has gone out and Shades walk the valley. Who will you be?

hud.new_ability_book: In your spellbook (P): drag it to your action bar
hud.recall_text: Return to your bed, or to the town hearth.
hud.eat_text: Eat the best food in your bags. Out of combat, food restores health quickly.

death.title: You have died
death.hint: You keep everything you carry. Release to wake at the hearth.
death.hint_survival: Your items are where you fell. Friends can pick them up too.

rpg.name: Moving

rpg.name: Fighting

Clear your target; close a window; open this menu

builder.name: Building
rows: Pick the block you look at

list.title: Finding your feet
list.text: Hold the right mouse button to steer and press W to walk. Hold both mouse buttons to run. The wheel zooms.

list.title: A gold ! is a quest
list.text: Someone with a gold ! above their head has work for you. Walk up and right-click them to talk.

list.title: The map
list.text: North is up. A yellow ! is a quest to take, a yellow ? one to hand in. The + and − buttons zoom.

list.title: Your quests
list.text: What each quest needs is listed here, and counts up as you go. Press L to read the whole story again.

list.title: Your target
list.text: This is what you have selected. The colour of its level tells you the danger: grey is trivial, yellow is a fair fight, red will kill you. Right-click it to attack.

list.title: Your abilities
list.text: You swing by yourself. Press 1, 2, 3 (or click) to use an ability. A dark sweep means it is recovering; a red tint means you are too far away or short of power.

list.title: Rage
list.text: The red bar is rage. It builds as you hit and are hit, and drains away after the fight: spend it while it lasts.

list.title: Energy
list.text: The yellow bar is energy. It comes back quickly by itself, so strike, wait a breath, and strike again.

list.title: Mana
list.text: The blue bar is mana. Spells spend it and it returns slowly. When it runs low, finish with your weapon, then rest or eat.

list.title: Combo points
list.text: Your strikes mark the target, up to five points. A finishing move spends them all: the more points, the harder it lands.

list.title: Experience
list.text: Kills and quests fill this bar. When it is full you gain a level: more health, harder hits, and now and then a new ability.

list.title: Loot
list.text: The creature carried something. Click an item to take it, or take everything. A body that sparkles still holds loot: right-click it.

list.title: Into your bags
list.text: What you receive is shown at the lower right and goes into your bags. Press B to open them.

list.title: Something to wear
list.text: Press B and point at it: green arrows show where it beats what you have on, red where it is worse. Right-click to put it on.

list.title: Bags
list.text: Right-click an item to wear it, eat it or use it. Grey items are junk: sell them to any merchant. Sort tidies everything up.

list.title: Ready to hand in
list.text: The quest turns green when it is done. Go back to the person named here (a gold ? on the map) for your reward.

list.title: You are badly hurt
list.text: Back away if you can. Out of combat, press = to eat: food brings your health back quickly.

list.title: A new ability
list.text: It is on your action bar, glowing. Point at it to read what it does. Drag buttons to rearrange them.

list.title: Spellbook
list.text: Everything your class learns and the level it arrives. Drag an ability onto the action bar to put it on a key.

list.title: Character
list.text: What you wear, and what it adds up to. Point at a number to see what it does for you.

list.title: Merchants
list.text: Click an item to buy it. Right-click things in your bags to sell them, or sell every grey item at once with Sell junk.

list.title: Rested
list.text: You rested at a hearth. Until the blue marker on this bar, kills give double experience.

list.title: Party
list.text: Your companions are listed under your own frame. Kills and quest credit are shared while you stay near each other. /p talks to the party.

list.title: Death is not the end
list.text: You lose nothing you carry. Release, and you wake at the nearest hearth.

panels.bags_hint: Right-click to wear, eat or use. Point at gear to compare it with what you have on.
panels.bags_hint_vendor: Right-click sells to the merchant. Shift + right-click wears or uses instead.
panels.bags_hint_trade: Right-click puts an item on the trade table.
panels.spellbook_hint: Drag an ability onto your action bar to put it on a key.
panels.skills_hint: Right-click a tree, an ore vein or a bush to gather from it. Each gathering teaches you a little more.

item.food: Use: restores {n}% of your health, out of combat.

health.name: Health
health.text: What you can take before you fall. Stamina raises it. It returns slowly out of combat, and quickly when you eat.

rage.name: Rage
rage.text: Built by hitting and being hit; spent on abilities. It drains away after a fight.

mana.name: Mana
mana.text: Spent on spells. Intellect gives you more; Spirit brings it back faster.

energy.name: Energy
energy.text: Spent on strikes and returns quickly by itself.

str.name: Strength
str.text: Raises your attack power: every swing of a weapon hits harder.

agi.name: Agility
agi.text: Raises your chance of a critical strike, and attack power for hunters and rogues.

int.name: Intellect
int.text: Each point gives 8 mana, and a little chance for spells to strike critically.

spi.name: Spirit
spi.text: Health comes back faster out of combat.

damage.name: Weapon damage
damage.text: What a swing of your main-hand weapon does before your attack power is added, and how often you swing.

dps.name: Damage per second
dps.text: What your auto-attack does over time, attack power included. The simplest way to compare two weapons.

attack_power.name: Attack power
attack_power.text: Adds damage to every weapon swing and weapon ability. It comes from Strength (and Agility for hunters and rogues).

spell_power.name: Spell power
spell_power.text: Adds to the damage and healing of your spells.

crit.name: Critical strike
crit.text: The chance that a weapon hit lands for double damage.

spell_crit.name: Spell critical
spell_crit.text: The chance that a spell lands for half as much again.

armor.name: Armour
armor.text: Reduces the physical damage you take from a creature of your level by the share shown.
